summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release declaring a semi-annual dividend of US$0.0125 per share. The dividend is payable to shareholders of record on June 5, 2026, with payment on or before June 25, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change involved. The filing simply reports a standard dividend declaration by the board.
